deviation: New York law matches the standard, but the forum is now "state and federal courts located in New York" instead of the courts at New York County. This could allow suit in any county or federal district in the state, and it adds a mandatory executive escalation step before any court action. The governing-law choice is unchanged, so the risk is low.
suggested_text: 13.1 Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of New York, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. 13.2 Dispute Resolution. The Parties shall first attempt to resolve any dispute through good-faith escalation to senior executives. Failing resolution within thirty (30) days, the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York shall have exclusive jurisdiction, and each Party submits to that jurisdiction. Nothing in this Section prevents either Party from seeking urgent injunctive relief at any time.
